EQUATION:
odeType = stiff

; Depot compartment (oral absorption)
depot(target = Ad, Tlag = Tlag)
ddt_Ad = -ka * Ad

; Central compartment
ddt_Ac = ka * Ad - (Cl/V1) * Ac - (Q/V1) * Ac + (Q/V2) * Ap

; Peripheral compartment
ddt_Ap = (Q/V1) * Ac - (Q/V2) * Ap

; Concentration in central compartment
Cc = Ac/V1
